name: nordic-supervisors
display_name: Nordic Financial Supervisors — FI, Finanstilsynet, FIN-FSA & FIUs
description: Structured knowledge graph for Nordic financial supervisory authorities and FIUs. Covers Finansinspektionen (SE), FIN-FSA (FI), Finanstilsynet (NO and DK), and the four Nordic FIUs (Finanspolisen, KRP, Økokrim, Hvidvasksekretariatet). Includes supervisory guidance, AML inspection methodology, enforcement powers, SAR filing processes, FATF mutual evaluations, and AMLA college participation.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
